mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (user_id, match_type, match_id, title, content, image, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{matchType}, #{matchId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{image}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT 'PERSONAL' AS matchType, m.personal_match_id AS matchId, m.title AS title FROM personal_match_participant p JOIN personal_match m ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = '결제완료' AND m.deleted = '0' AND m.status = '경기 종료' AND p.attendance = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.match_type = 'PERSONAL' AND r.match_id = m.personal_match_id AND r.deleted = 0) ORDER BY m.match_date DESC

SELECT 'TEAM' AS matchType, m.team_match_id AS matchId, m.title AS title FROM team_match_participant p JOIN team_match m ON m.team_match_id = p.team_match_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = '결제완료' AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = '경기 종료' AND p.attendance = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.match_type = 'TEAM' AND r.match_id = m.team_match_id AND r.deleted = '0') ORDER BY m.match_date DESC

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, r.match_type AS matchType, r.match_id AS matchId, COALESCE(pm.title, tm.title) AS matchTitle, r.title AS title, SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.image, ',', 1) AS image, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM review r JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN personal_match pm ON r.match_type = 'PERSONAL' AND pm.personal_match_id = r.match_id LEFT JOIN team_match tm ON r.match_type = 'TEAM' AND tm.team_match_id = r.match_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.review_id DESC LIMIT #{row}, 9

SELECT count(*) FROM review r JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN personal_match pm ON r.match_type = 'PERSONAL' AND pm.personal_match_id = r.match_id LEFT JOIN team_match tm ON r.match_type = 'TEAM' AND tm.team_match_id = r.match_id WHERE r.deleted = '0'

SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.user_id AS userId, r.match_type AS matchType, r.match_id AS matchId, COALESCE(pm.title, tm.title) AS matchTitle, COALESCE(pm.sport, tm.sport) AS sport, r.title AS title, r.content AS content, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_like l WHERE l.review_id = r.review_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.review_id = r.review_id) AS commentCount FROM review r JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN personal_match pm ON r.match_type = 'PERSONAL' AND pm.personal_match_id = r.match_id LEFT JOIN team_match tm ON r.match_type = 'TEAM' AND tm.team_match_id = r.match_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.review_id DESC LIMIT #{row}, 5

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN personal_match pm ON r.match_type = 'PERSONAL' AND pm.personal_match_id = r.match_id LEFT JOIN team_match tm ON r.match_type = 'TEAM' AND tm.team_match_id = r.match_id WHERE r.deleted = 0
AND r.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image = #{image}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE review SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
